notes.title: Fix for Early Access saves
notes.content:
Hey folks! This is a minor patch that shouldn't impact most users.

- Saves no longer store macro data, making Early Access saves fully compatible with the final game.

There have been a few reports of issues with saves made during Early Access crashing during trials. As the issue had to do with save data and was avoidable with minimal inconvenience by starting from Chapter Select, we gave this a little time to test it thoroughly before releasing, but we've pushed the fix out to everyone now. If you were on the "beta" branch due to this issue, you can safely switch back to "default".

This should also make your saves take up a little bit less space, and make bugs of this type less likely in the future.

notes.title: Full game available now!
notes.content:
Master Magistrate is finally out of Early Access! Our warmest thanks to everyone who's supported the game.

The full story is available now, with all its twists and turns. 

In each case, you meet suspects and fraternize with allies and enemies before moving between different locations and interviewing witnesses to piece together more evidence. Finally the case comes to trial and, as prescribed by historical Japanese law, you preside as magistrate—judge and jury in one—to uncover the truth and bring justice to the criminal. A samurai’s best weapon may be his sword, but the magistrate’s words are his weapon.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762385/54168b337197cf4f98fccdb993220d1175af4dcb.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762385/a16cb6ce792c5f35b7669a8700ceb7bf6566b09c.jpg[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762385/fcb0326156d9ee42d9f0bd9ac34d0879ceefbd87.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762385/b2b21c2ff85b27e665e02e27c673f4f056043361.jpg[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762385/4f5d35987a44f7fe44d962c541f37363cc7c22e1.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762385/39c10759bd54cbc5f259ca20d1a31540ccb99819.jpg[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762385/01f2dca80150d4cb25de11dc6d677a949b2d4ca9.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762385/5aa7b554c3e0c4031523c7da53995defe677084c.jpg[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762385/dcb237f33d11c07f4ebb2ca7d52243978539f6a1.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762385/fad54dc22a9e82bee21369cbc45a35b425ff04b7.jpg[/img][/url]

[h1]The Story[/h1]

[h2]Chapter 1: Ouka Riot[/h2]
Meet the people of Oukacho, the samurai police of the shogunate, and the warrior vigilantes of the Shinsengumi. A young girl is found covered in blood⁠—standing over the gory corpse of a ferryman, brutally murdered in his own home. How did she do it? Could she somehow be innocent? And if she didn't⁠ do it—who did?

[h2]Chapter 2: Burnout Engine[/h2]
When a fire breaks out in a residential building, the Magistrate's Office's star mechanic Rimu is there to save the day. In the aftermath, though, it falls to the magistrate to investigate the cause. A sushi salesman, a petty brigand, and Rimu's mentor all witnessed the fire, but can you cut through the flames of confusion and lies and sift truth from the ashes?

[h2]Chapter 3: Tempered Steel[/h2]
The town's biggest moneylender is dead in his basement, and the town's most famous thief is back from the dead and admitting to the crime. Is he telling the truth? What could he be hiding, and why? And why has a man who should have been executed spent the last sixteen years in a dungeon?

[h2]Chapter 4: Shogun’s Justice[/h2]
A series of atrocities roils the city. Could the roots of conspiracy stretch deeper still into the past—and wider in the present? Can those roots be severed or will they strangle the future—and nourish themselves on the magistrate’s blood?

notes.title: Content Update & Release Plans
notes.content:
New bonus content, UI improvements, and an update on release timing!

[h2]New Content[/h2]
This update adds the bonus scenario chapter included in pre-order versions of the Japanese release.

[i]When all the girls' clothes go missing, leaving them stranded in their underwear, it's up to Shimei to stay on task long enough to uncover the truth! What villainous brigand would dare do such a dastardly deed?! What terrible fate has befallen the missing Hijikata and Kondo?! Discover the answers to these critical questions and more![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762385/e85dc49126e31d1e6e5f543f8756e25015d790af.png[/img]

This chapter unlocks after completing Chapter 3! It's a whole lot shorter and a heck of a lot less serious than any of the main chapters, but we hope you don't mind a little spicy silliness. Now available in both English and Chinese! You can access this chapter from...

[h2]Improved Chapter Select[/h2]
The initial Chapter Select screen in the first Early Access version had two problems.

[i]One[/i], it only barely had room to display all the content in the game [i]without[/i] the bonus chapter, and it couldn't do it prettily. Going horizontal has its price.
[i]Two[/i], a lot of people never even noticed it.

We hope you'll agree that this new version looks better, and it's certainly capable of supporting the full content of the game.

To avoid spoilers, this is the most minimal possible version of the new chapter select screen.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762385/3ba24e0b0cf0124b8dd5ad1ce7354bc148dce857.png[/img]

Looks a little bare-bones, right? Play a little and it should start to look a lot more populated!

In addition to adding new chapters as you unlock them, it'll also now get a little fancier according to your progress...! And, in order to help new players find this screen, the Start button now changes to say Chapter Select after the first time you start the game.

This is a really great feature that's always made the game a lot easier to navigate on repeated visits, so we hope more players will take advantage of it now!

[h2]Improved Chinese Localization[/h2]
The Chinese team took another pass over the whole game looking to find and remove misspellings and other typographical errors. Additionally, we took another look at formatting to make the whole thing a bit easier on the eyes.

[h2]Release Plans[/h2]
We expect the whole game to be fully translated, edited, and ready for release in [b]May 2020![/b] Follow us on Twitter [url=https://twitter.com/shira_vn]@shira_vn[/url] for all our news that's fit to share!

notes.title: The Accountant Patch
notes.content:
This is The Accountant Patch. These notes also include a summary of disparate fixes made over the course of a week or two.

Many of the changes detailed below are [i]extremely trivial[/i], so strap in and get ready for a wild ride!

[h1]Visual and Functionality Fixes[/h1]
[list][*]Corrected a line overflow error when obtaining the Motor item in Chapter 2
[*]Corrected an error in which Iidenosuke's character sprite was mispositioned, which originated from the shift to a horizontal UI
[*]Caught choice buttons twitching when clicked and corrected the issue
[*]Fixed an issue where the Clues button appeared overlapping with a text window after an Argument
[*]Made it easier to access the History while reviewing evidence to present during a trial[/list]

[h1]English Text Fixes[/h1]
[list][*]Corrected a typo in Ideha's character bio.
[*]Corrected line breaking for several decisions in Chapter 3.
[*]Corrected several instances of inconsistent capitalization surrounding stuttered remarks.
[*]Corrected Koume's use of honorifics to be more accurate and consistent. This might be more important than you would think...
[*]Altered the line introducing the mountain temple Ritsuganji to make it easier to parse.
[*]Renamed the evidence "Sakatas' Use of Oil" to "The Sakatas' Use of Oil"
[*]Miscellaneous text adjustments.[/list]

[h1]Accountancy Fixes[/h1]
We have been informed that an Accountant must possess a college degree. As the availability of degrees from properly certified educational institutions during the Ouka period of pseudo-Japanese history is dubious, we hereby grant Ryu Ootaki the rank of Honorary Accountant, just in case.

She is referred to as an "accountant" in-game and no longer calls herself a "bookkeeper", an act of self-debasement which would, we are informed, tear to tatters the pride of any true accountant.
We have ambiguated the accounting capacity of Koume Kawai to non-specific financial operations.

[i]Additionally[/i], we have taken another look at the use of Numbers in the game and tightened up the cases in which they are written out longform and when they are written with numerals. We now prefer to write them out longform, except in cases where they are both large and specific, and in cases in which they refer to an hour of the day.

[b][i]Finally[/i][/b], we also made a few internal changes to reduce the duplication of lines, which makes it a lot harder for bugs to appear and should help facilitate the translation of Chapter 4.

notes.title: Minor Bugfix (Chinese Only)
notes.content:
This is a small fix for one specific bug in the Chinese release.
- Chinese: Fix incorrectly swapped character bios for Sakura and Koume in Chapter 3

notes.title: Day Two Tweaks and Fixes
notes.content:
Our Chinese localization team pointed out a few things for us to fix! We also adjusted the default settings. If you're already playing, these won't overwrite your existing settings.

- Made some corrections to the Chinese text, and tweaked one or two lines slightly in the English version.
- Adjusted the default Text Area Opacity from 50% to 75% to help address concerns with readability. It might be overkill, so feel free to adjust this setting on your own from the System Settings menu!
- Adjusted the default Voice Volume from 50% to 80%, to make sure that it's louder than the music without needing special correction.
- Fixed a bug in which the last CG available in Early Access could not be unlocked. This CG should now correctly unlock at the very end of the currently available portion of the story.

notes.title: Day-One Bugfixes
notes.content:
We pushed three small patches today to fix two visual issues with the game's appearance and one with its behavior on certain PCs.

- Fixed a bug that caused the Load button to display out of place on the settings screen
- Fixed a bug that caused fonts to be set incorrectly the first time the game was launched
- Fixed a bug that caused the game to crash at launch in some cases due to an encoding issue

notes.title: Master Magistrate now available in Early Access!
notes.content:
The samurai detective game Master Magistrate is now available in Early Access! Solve three puzzling mysteries as you get to know the game's cast of cute girls, dependable daddies, and colorful townspeople!

[h1]Chapter 1: Ouka Riot[/h1]
Meet the people of Oukacho, the samurai police of the shogunate, and the warrior vigilantes of the Shinsengumi. A young girl is found covered in blood⁠—standing over the gory corpse of a ferryman, brutally murdered in his own home. How did she do it? Could she somehow be innocent? And if she didn't⁠ do it—who did?

[h1]Chapter 2: Burnout Engine[/h1]
When a fire breaks out in a residential building, the Magistrate's Office's star mechanic Rimu is there to save the day. In the aftermath, though, it falls to the magistrate to investigate the cause. A sushi salesman, a petty brigand, and Rimu's mentor all witnessed the fire, but can you cut through the flames of confusion and lies and sift the truth from the ashes?

[h1]Chapter 3: Tempered Steel[/h1]
The town's biggest moneylender is dead in his basement, and the town's most famous thief is back from the dead and admitting to the crime. Is he telling the truth? What could he be hiding, and why? And why has a man who should have been executed spent the last sixteen years in a dungeon?

[h1]Golly, mister, three whole chapters?[/h1]
Yep! Investigate, examine, and expose all the answers today in over ten hours of gameplay!
And if, while you're at it, you should happen to detect a localization bug or typo—please let us know!

[h1]Wait, what [i]isn't[/i] available yet in Early Access, again?[/h1]
Glad you asked!
[list][*]The main story's final chapter
[*]The post-story, adult-only branching romance routes for each character
[*]The most polished possible experience
[/list]
Those things are planned for release next year. If you're ready to play anyway, then come on and jump in now! We think the game is a lot of fun as-is, and it will only get better from here.
